+# Round-35 K05 control: log reader only; deliberately no filesystem sweep.
+probe_pacnew_plane() {
+  local line kind source target log_pacnew=0 log_pacsave=0 gone=0
+  local new_re='^\[[^]]*\] \[ALPM\] warning: (.+) installed as (.+)$'
+  local save_re='^\[[^]]*\] \[ALPM\] warning: (.+) saved as (.+)$'
+  local -A targets=()
+  if [ -r "$PACMAN_LOG" ]; then
+    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
+      if [[ $line =~ $new_re ]]; then
+        kind=pacnew
+      elif [[ $line =~ $save_re ]]; then
+        kind=pacsave
+      else
+        continue
+      fi
+      source=${BASH_REMATCH[1]} target=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
+      [[ $target = "$source.$kind" ]] || continue
+      if [ "$kind" = pacnew ]; then
+        log_pacnew=$((log_pacnew + 1))
+      else
+        log_pacsave=$((log_pacsave + 1))
+      fi
+      if [[ $target = /etc/* ]]; then targets["$target"]=1; fi
+    done < "$PACMAN_LOG"
+  fi
+  for target in "${!targets[@]}"; do gone=$((gone + 1)); done
+  printf 'DRIFT pacnew-plane pacnew=0 pacsave=0 pacorig=0 unreadable=0 log_pacnew=%d log_pacsave=%d unlogged=0 gone=%d\n' \
+    "$log_pacnew" "$log_pacsave" "$gone"
+}
+
 # ---- main --------------------------------------------------------------------
 main() {
   local selftest=0
@@ -2756,6 +2786,7 @@ main() {

   probe_update_safety

   printf 'PLANE systemd: %s (%s)\n' "$SYS_V" "$SYS_NOTE"
